story: You are a researcher at the University of California, Berkeley, conducting a longitudinal study called 'The Future of Work and Well-being.' You are collecting data on various aspects of employment and policy to understand how different factors influence job satisfaction, employee well-being, and overall workforce dynamics. The dataset includes information on employment status, education level, industry sector, work experience, hourly wage, job satisfaction, union membership, health insurance coverage, minimum wage policy, and more, aiming to provide insights into the impact of labor policies on workers across different sectors.
